memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports mild stiffness in small joints of hands, able to perform ADLs independently, walks 2 km daily without aid.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), no concerns.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 8 regular (methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD, metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety, PHQ-2 score 0.
carers: Husband, Mr Suresh Kulkarni, provides support with medication dosing.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep working without pain."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Messaged via app: Morning joint stiffness worse in fingers, taking extra paracetamol. Blood sugars fasting around 140 mg/dL. No new symptoms.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Stiffness improved slightly, still reports difficulty opening jars; walks 1.5 km with occasional cane.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual due next visit).
falls: One fall at home 3 months ago (tripped on rug), no injury; gait cautious, timed up-and-go 13 seconds (≥12) – raised fall risk, advise strength training and supportive footwear.
medicines: 8 regular (same as before) – polypharmacy, Beers review pending.
mood: Reports occasional worry about work, PHQ-2 score 1.
carers: Husband, Mr Suresh Kulkarni, assists with medication box.
goals: "I want to reduce pain and avoid another fall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Hand X-ray: periarticular osteopenia, mild joint space narrowing at MCP2-3, no erosions. Consistent with early rheumatoid arthritis changes.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Dr S. Rao, for consideration of biologic DMARD due to persistent activity despite methotrexate increase. Include recent labs and X-ray.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Rheumatology review: patient advised to continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, add sulfasalazine 500 mg BD, monitor LFT. No biologic at this time. Return to primary care in 3 months.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Slight improvement in grip, able to open jars with effort; walks 2 km unaided.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw mild abnormality) – positive screen, schedule MoCA in 1 month.
falls: No new falls; gait steady, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular (added sulfasalazine 500 mg BD) – polypharmacy, Beers review ongoing.
mood: Denies depression, PHQ-2 0.
carers: Husband, Mr Suresh Kulkarni, reminds about sulfasalazine dosing.
goals: "I want to keep working full‑time and stay independent."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: App message: Noticed a small sore on left heel that isn’t healing, worried about diabetic foot. Blood sugars fasting 130-150 mg/dL. No fever.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports heel sore painful, limits walking to 500 m; hand function stable.
cognition: MoCA performed 2026-01-15 score 24/30, normal.
falls: No falls; gait antalgic due to heel pain, timed up-and-go 14 seconds (≥12) – raised fall risk, advise heel off‑loading shoe and physiotherapy.
medicines: 9 regular (same) – polypharmacy, Beers review documented.
mood: Frustrated about heel sore, PHQ-2 score 1.
carers: Husband, Mr Suresh Kulkarni, helps with dressing changes.
goals: "I want the heel to heal so I can walk to work again."
